name: screenshot-manager
title: Screenshot Manager
description: Browse and paste screenshots from a configurable directory.
author: local

commands.name: index-screenshots
commands.title: Index Screenshots
commands.description: Extract text from screenshots for content search.

commands.name: delete-old-screenshots
commands.title: Delete Old Screenshots
commands.description: Delete screenshots older than the configured retention period.

commands.name: paste-last-screenshot
commands.title: Paste Last Screenshot
commands.description: Paste the newest screenshot into the focused app.

preferences.name: retentionPeriod
preferences.title: Screenshot retention
preferences.description: Delete command retention period. Defaults to Unlimited.

scripts.build: swiftc -O -framework CoreGraphics -framework Foundation -framework Vision scripts/ocr.swift -o assets/screenshot-ocr && ray build -e dist -o .build && cp .build/*.js . && rm -rf .build
